---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
attacks <- read_csv("data/attacks_clean.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Country_lower = str_to_lower(str_trim(Country)),
    Fatal_clean = case_when(
      str_trim(Fatal) == "Y" ~ "Fatal",
      str_trim(Fatal) == "N" ~ "Non-fatal",
      .default = "Unknown"
    )
  )

write_rds(attacks, "data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
country_counts <- attacks |>
  count(Country_lower, name = "attacks")

map_data("world") |>
  mutate(Country_lower = str_to_lower(region)) |>
  left_join(country_counts, by = join_by(Country_lower)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = attacks)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10", na.value = "grey90") +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Shark attacks by country, 1900 to present",
    fill = "Attacks",
    caption = "Source: Global Shark Attack File"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
